executable_future_method.execution_user: The same macOS guest user that owns the fresh Hub database and its owner-only parent directory.
executable_future_method.sqlite_open: Canonical single-link owner-only regular database opened with URI mode=ro, followed by PRAGMA query_only=ON and a verified query_only value of 1.
executable_future_method.schema_gate: PRAGMA user_version must be at least 58 and all six Hub/Edge ledger tables must exist.
executable_future_method.output: One strict JSON observation with hashed selectors/store identity, lineage frontier, every application and sequence classification, non-complete pending publications, and accumulator metadata with state bytes represented only by size and SHA-256.

fixture_proof.fixture_shape: One lineage with three applications and three sequences: lifecycle, projected VehicleName, lifecycle; one complete publication and one accumulator.
fixture_proof.missing_database_behavior: Fails before sqlite3 connect and does not create the missing path.

runtime_contract.before_start: Stage and rehash this exact observer with the fresh r7 Hub/fixture candidate. Prove the target Hub database path and parent are owned/readable by the exact observer user before any runtime.
runtime_contract.baseline: Run once after Hub checkpoint/readiness and require zero selected lineage/application/sequence/non-complete-publication/accumulator rows. Any open, ownership, schema or query error fails the baseline; it is never converted to zero.
runtime_contract.post_event: Run after the Hub durable commit/frontier settles and record every sequence row ordered by spool_seq. Require exactly one projected_telemetry application for VehicleName, classify all additional lifecycle records by their actual category/reason, and bind frontier/pending/accumulator state without assuming one datum equals one sequence.
runtime_contract.repeatability: The observer may be invoked at named baseline and post-event checkpoints only; each invocation is read-only and separately hashed in the owner-only runtime receipt.

precise_limits: The focused fixture proves the observer's same-owner read-only open, schema checks, exact row extraction and non-creation behavior; no r6/r7 guest or live Hub database was opened in this review.
This does not prove that a future guest path has the expected ownership or that a live database is readable. The pre-start ownership probe and first zero-baseline invocation remain mandatory.
The earlier SQLite error 14 is not treated as resolved by assertion. A repeat error closes the future baseline before event authorization.
proof_boundary: This is source and synthetic-fixture proof for a bounded read-only observer. It is not live ledger, runtime, Edge, Hub forwarding, event, package, service, release, production, vehicle or user acceptance evidence.
